acceptance.heading: Acceptance criteria
acceptance.text:
- [ ] A phase whose artifact paths are unreachable from the builder's resolved working directory is refused before dispatch, exit 2, naming the path and the directory.
- [ ] A test covers the `--target-root` + `--phases-dir` topology specifically, since that is the one that dispatched and then failed silently.
- [ ] Two consecutive no-op builder turns escalate without running to the round cap.
- [ ] `ESCALATION.md` records the number of builder blocks appended.
- [ ] Each preflight check reports under a distinct name in the run log.

label: draft; preflight and independent plan QA outstanding

scope.heading: frontmatter goal
scope.text: A phase whose artifact paths are unreachable from the builder's resolved working directory is refused before dispatch with a named path and directory, instead of dispatching four no-op builder turns and escalating as cap-stalled after 29 minutes.

title: No preflight checks the builder can reach a phase's artifact paths — the phase burns its full round cap writing nothing
